lessons.title: Explain dimensions before ordering furniture
lessons.objective: Explain dimensions before ordering furniture: Italian largo means wide, not large and not long.
lessons.explanation:
Italian largo means wide, not large and not long. Long is lungo and large or big is grande; choose the word that makes the dimension clear.
Il corridoio è lungo, ma non è largo. — The corridor is long, but it is not wide.
Abbiamo bisogno di un tavolo grande per la riunione. — We need a large table for the meeting.

lessons.title: Repair a shopping list on a trip
lessons.objective: Repair a shopping list on a trip: La zuppa is soup, i vestiti are clothes and il sapone is soap.
lessons.explanation:
La zuppa is soup, i vestiti are clothes and il sapone is soap. A preservative is un conservante, because un preservativo is a condom; use the situation, not the familiar-looking English word.
Al negozio compro il sapone per lavare i vestiti. — At the shop I buy soap to wash the clothes.
Una corda serve a chiudere la borsa. — A rope serves to close the bag.
